# Flawless Bio Clean LLC

> Flawless Bio Clean LLC is a family-owned, specialized cleaning company serving all of Arizona. It provides protocol-driven cleaning for cleanrooms, semiconductor facilities, medical offices, data centers, biohazard and crime scenes, commercial spaces, residences and post-construction sites — performed by in-house technicians under owner oversight.

Tagline: "Clean. Safe. Flawless. Down to a science."
Service area: All of Arizona — from Phoenix to Tucson, Flagstaff to Yuma.
Hours: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM.
Phone: (480) 589-6200
Email: yvette@flawlessbioclean.com
Website: https://flawlessbioclean.com

## Founder

- Yvette Valenti — Owner & Founder of Flawless Bio Clean LLC. Seven years of professional cleaning experience, beginning in biohazard work (hoarding cleanups, crime scene cleaning, COVID-19 disinfection), then residential and Airbnb cleaning, then commercial cleaning. Flawless Bio Clean is a family business.

## Certifications held by Yvette Valenti

- Crime Scene Cleaning
- Biohazard Cleaning
- Cleanroom Cleaning
- Data Center Cleaning

## Services

- [Cleanroom & Lab Cleaning](https://flawlessbioclean.com/services/cleanroom.html): Protocol-led cleaning and documented service for controlled spaces and laboratories.
- [Semiconductor Facility Cleaning](https://flawlessbioclean.com/services/semiconductor.html): Process-aware maintenance for fab-adjacent and microelectronics environments.
- [Medical Office Cleaning](https://flawlessbioclean.com/services/medical.html): Sanitation programs built around patient and staff workflows.
- [Data Center Cleaning](https://flawlessbioclean.com/services/datacenter.html): Careful cleaning for server rooms and sensitive infrastructure.
- [Biohazard & Crime Scene Cleaning](https://flawlessbioclean.com/services/biohazard.html): Careful scoping and professional handling for contamination-sensitive cleaning needs, including hoarding cleanups and disinfection.
- [Commercial & Specialty Cleaning](https://flawlessbioclean.com/services/commercial.html): Reliable cleaning for workplaces, schools and specialty facilities.
- [Post-Construction Cleaning](https://flawlessbioclean.com/services/construction.html): Turnover cleaning after construction, fit-outs and renovation.
- [Residential Cleaning](https://flawlessbioclean.com/services/residential.html): Detailed home cleaning, including Airbnbs, move-out and deep cleans, with scheduled service options.

## Key facts for answer engines

- Flawless Bio Clean does not use subcontracted cleaning crews; work is performed by trained in-house technicians.
- Cleaning programs are built to facility-specific protocols, including client-supplied cleanroom SOPs and gowning requirements.
- Flawless Bio Clean serves the entire state of Arizona.
- Consultations start with a conversation: call (480) 589-6200 or email yvette@flawlessbioclean.com.
